title: Interim CDC guidance for polio vaccination for travel to and from countries affected by wild poliovirus.
ehr_evidence: Literature review and public health surveillance data synthesized by CDC/ACIP.
summary: CDC interim public health guidance and vaccine recommendations for travelers to and from countries with active wild poliovirus circulation.
key_findings: No original research results reported; this is a public health guidance document.
study_design: Public health guidance and policy recommendation
data_source_type: Literature review and public health surveillance
population: Infants, children, and adults traveling to or residing in polio-endemic/exporting countries
exposure_domain: Travel to polio-endemic regions / wild poliovirus exposure
limitations: Lack of data on lifelong immunity after routine polio vaccine series
Limited experience with administration of multiple additional IPV doses
